concept.title: Creating the QuayIntegration custom resource
concept.shortdesc: The QuayIntegration custom resource connects your OpenShift Container Platform cluster to a Red Hat Quay registry and defines the configuration that the Quay Bridge Operator uses to synchronize projects, organizations, and robot accounts.

conbody.p: The QuayIntegration custom resource can be created by using the OpenShift Container Platform web console, or from the command-line interface.
